description: Create a UIDWatch account and get its API key. The key is shown only in this answer: keep it and send it as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" in the configuration of the MCP client, which every other tool needs. accept_terms must be true: it accepts the terms of service (https://uidwatch.tollwyn.com/terms?via=mcp-registry), including the data processing terms in section 8, on behalf of the business that signs up. The trial lasts 30 days and watches 20 entries until a person confirms the email address from the mail UIDWatch sends, then 2500. via is an optional partner id; without one the account counts as signed up through MCP.

accept_terms.description: Accepts the terms at https://uidwatch.tollwyn.com/terms?via=mcp-registry, including the data processing terms in section 8, on behalf of the business that signs up.

via.description: Optional partner id: lower-case words joined by hyphens
